title: Rename “Weekday” to “Mid-week” terminology across attendance UI (frontend-only)

requirements.summary: Update the Record Attendance modal meeting type dropdown to use “Mid-week Meeting” (label + stored value) while preserving compatibility with legacy “Weekday Meeting” records.
acceptanceCriteria: When opening the Record Attendance modal, the meeting type dropdown shows "Mid-week Meeting" and "Weekend Meeting" options.
Selecting "Mid-week Meeting" submits/saves the meetingType value as exactly "Mid-week Meeting".
No other labels, validation messages, or behaviors in the modal change.

file_operations.description: Replace the SelectItem option label/value "Weekday Meeting" with "Mid-week Meeting" (keeping "Weekend Meeting" unchanged), and normalize edit-mode prefill so legacy stored values of "Weekday Meeting" are treated as "Mid-week Meeting" for selection + save behavior.

requirements.summary: Change attendance statistics summary wording from “Average weekday attendance” to “Average mid-week attendance” without altering calculations or layout.
acceptanceCriteria: The attendance statistics section displays "Average mid-week attendance" (and continues to display the weekend label unchanged).
No other statistics wording, calculations, or layout changes occur.

file_operations.description: Update the rendered label text from "Average weekday attendance" to "Average mid-week attendance" and leave the weekend label and all rendering/calculation behavior unchanged.

requirements.summary: Ensure meeting attendance record cards display “Mid-week Meeting” wherever “Weekday Meeting” appears, without changing other card fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Attendance record cards never display the phrase "Weekday Meeting".
Cards display "Mid-week Meeting" in its place, while leaving other card fields (date badge, counts, names, actions) unchanged.

file_operations.description: Adjust the attendance record card title rendering so that when a record's meetingType is the legacy "Weekday Meeting" value it displays as "Mid-week Meeting", while leaving all other rendered fields and actions unchanged.

requirements.summary: Remove remaining user-facing “Weekday” wording across the frontend and keep mid-week stats/filters compatible with both legacy “Weekday” and new “Mid-week” stored values.
acceptanceCriteria: A sweep of the frontend UI finds no remaining user-visible occurrences of the word "Weekday".

Mid-week average calculations and any mid-week filtering/aggregation continue to include both legacy "Weekday" records and new "Mid-week" records so historical data remains reflected in the mid-week stats.

file_operations.description: Update mid-week (currently "weekday") attendance classification logic so it includes both legacy "Weekday" meetingType strings and new "Mid-week" meetingType strings, while keeping weekend classification unchanged.
Confirm no remaining user-visible "Weekday" text remains in this component after the label change (ensure weekend wording remains unchanged).
Confirm no remaining user-visible "Weekday" text remains in the modal UI after updating the dropdown option, while keeping all validation messages and behaviors unchanged.
Confirm no remaining user-visible "Weekday" text is rendered in attendance cards after applying legacy-to-new display mapping, while leaving weekend rendering unchanged.
